issues.title: P0: Activate server-side repository protection
issues.body:
## Scope

Apply and verify main/tag protection. Owner explicitly chose public visibility on 2026-10-20 after private protection returned HTTP 403. Check accepted collaborator access separately. REQ-01/02.

## Acceptance

GitHub API confirms main protection and both tag rulesets. Harmless direct main update is rejected. Local hooks and both CI checks work. Independent approving review remains required; never self-approve.

issues.title: P0: Confirm deadline, full rules and news-feed wording
issues.body:
## Scope

REQ-02/23. Obtain official deadline with timezone, full regulations/IP terms and explanation of the news-feed sentence on page 7.

## Acceptance

Record sources and timestamp; update config/team.json and requirements. Do not invent organiser answers.

Owner and reviewer: agree within the team; no automatic assignment.

issues.title: P1: Implement contextual events and news feed
issues.body:
## Scope

Page 7 asks to show news-feed changes by customer. Clarification pending; design a small context-sensitive feed with transparent synthetic sources.

## Acceptance

Two customers see relevant content and application events; isolation verified; update scope when organiser clarifies.

Owner and reviewer: agree within the team; no automatic assignment.

issues.title: P0: Verify jury access and freeze deadline version
issues.body:
## Scope

REQ-02/03. Repository is public by owner choice; verify unauthenticated read access to exact submission URL. If visibility changes to private, verify accepted alfa-hack-2026 access and consider personal write versus organisation Read.

## Acceptance

Final CI/E2E and clean-PC evidence, backup, full SHA/tag, manifest and submission receipt before official deadline. Deadline is currently unknown.
